analysis: Both changed files are documentation only: docs/developer/test.md adds a 'Deadline Admission Estimators' test section (the supplied head excerpt starts at line 500 and does not show the new lines at 113-138, which were seen only in the patch excerpt), and docs/provider/cli-reference.md line 1687 adds a row to the daemon-forwarded environment variable table for DARKBLOOM_TTFT_ADMISSION_FIXES, pointing at AdmissionRateEstimators.swift (DeadlineAdmissionFixes.environmentKey). No code, protocol, attestation, key, crypto or cache-storage behavior changes. The doc text states the tests use scripted engines and synthetic usage, make no live-qualification claims, and need no Metal library. Threat model relevance: the new env var appears to be a TTFT/admission-deadline kill switch. It is not tied to the T-041 prefix-cache gate (DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE), the TTL, the HMAC lookup or the account scoping. It does not alter T-053 or T-054 authorization or qualification semantics, and it adds no new trust boundary. Open questions for later passes, which cannot be resolved from docs: (1) whether the forwarded variable can influence admission decisions in ways that expose a timing oracle (SEC-035 stays accepted); (2) whether it is forwarded through launchd or the daemon environment safely. The source files referenced here are not in this batch, so those code paths are unreviewed. No regression is identified from the documentation alone.
